summary: Five test home-isolation helpers now also set USERPROFILE/HOMEDRIVE/HOMEPATH to the temp home (in addition to HOME), so os.UserHomeDir() cannot resolve to the real user dir on Windows.
reason: os.UserHomeDir() reads USERPROFILE on Windows, so the HOME-only isolation was a no-op and the suite leaked into the real user state dirs (.local/share, .local/state, .config under the real profile). Symptom: TestMCPSQLMissingStoreIsActionable and the teach-log/journal tests failed with entries from real-world CLI use (87 journal entries, 95 teach-log lines). Test-only change; zero behavior change on POSIX. Same fix as the greenhouse and lever prints.
validated_outcome: Full go test ./... suite passes (12 packages) on Windows after the fix; identical behavior on POSIX (the extra env vars are ignored there).
